relationships.subject: CSF CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Concentration of C-CGRP was significantly higher in painful dogs

relationships.subject: Syringomyelia
relationships.evidence_quote: No significant difference in C-CGRP concentration was noted between dogs with (median 99.3, range 0-226.6 pg/mL) and without (median 102.2, range 6.0-266.2 pg/mL) SM (p = 0.305).

key_findings: CSF CGRP was higher in painful Cavalier King Charles Spaniels with Chiari-like malformation regardless of syringomyelia.
CSF CGRP correlated with owner pain score but not with syrinx width.
